div.head: V Atr 26
div.ab: Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forð georne wordes ⁊ dæda; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forð georne wordes ⁊ dæde; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forð georne wordes ⁊ dæda; þonne wurð þisse þeode sona God milde.
Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forð georne wordes and dæde; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
But the law of God shall henceforth be zealously cherished both in word and in deed; then forthwith God will have mercy upon this nation.
But God’s law is to be willingly embraced henceforth in word and deed; then will God immediately show mercy to this people.
But God’s law henceforth is to be eagerly loved by word and deed; then God will at once become gracious to this nation.
Sondern man achte hinfort Gottes Gebot sorgsam in Wort und That; dann wird Gott alsbald diesem Volke gnädig werden.
But let God's law be eagerly loved henceforth in word and deed; then God will soon become merciful to this people.
